panels.title: gNBs connected
panels.description: AMF metric `gnb`.

panels.title: UEs on the RAN
panels.description: AMF metric `ran_ue`.

panels.title: PDU sessions at the UPF
panels.description: UPF gauge. A lower bound: after a UE restart it read 21 for 20 real sessions. The exact per-slice count is the SMF panel below.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: All Open5GS exporters plus the slice traffic exporter.

panels.title: PDU sessions per slice
panels.description: Native SMF gauge, labelled by S-NSSAI — slice identity that free5GC's metrics never carried.

panels.title: User-plane QoS flows per slice (UPF, by DNN)
panels.description: UPF gauge; DNN internet = eMBB, urllc = URLLC, iot = mMTC. Presence per slice; can over-count after a UE restart. The SMF's qos_flow_nbr{snssai,fiveqi} is NOT shown: it read 20/20 against 10/10 real flows because it is never decremented on re-attach.

panels.title: Liveness and latency — measured from the UEs
eMBB UEs reachable (of 20)
panels.description: UEs whose probe through the UPF answered in the last 5 s round. Core metrics do not notice vanished UEs; this does.

panels.title: URLLC worst RTT (budget 10 ms)
panels.description: Worst UE of the last round, UE -> gNB -> UPF gateway. SLICE_B_MAX_LATENCY_MS = 10.

panels.title: Round-trip time per slice (avg and worst UE)
panels.description: Probed every 5 s from every UE interface. Measured: with eMBB saturated, URLLC average RTT did not rise but up to 4 of 10 URLLC probes per round went unanswered; its worst case exceeded 10 ms even at idle.

panels.title: User plane — measured traffic per slice
Downlink throughput per slice
panels.description: Measured from the slice's own UPF TUN device (ogstun = eMBB, ogstun2 = URLLC, ogstun3 = mMTC). Open5GS's native UPF volume counters are labelled only by QFI and cannot separate slices.

panels.title: Uplink throughput per slice
panels.description: Measured from the slice's own UPF TUN device.

panels.title: Dropped packets per slice
panels.description: Drops on the slice's UPF device. AMBR policing happens in the gNB, so it does not show here.

panels.title: Phase 2b KPIs — each slice's own service, measured device to data network (ADR-015)
URLLC latency p99 (target 10 ms)
panels.description: One-way, device -> URLLC data network, last 60 s. 64-byte packets every 20 ms from all 10 devices. Target: 5QI 82 packet delay budget.

panels.title: mMTC devices reporting (of 70)
panels.description: Devices heard from in the last 90 s. Each sends a 10-byte report every 10 s.

panels.title: mMTC report latency p99
panels.description: TR 38.913 small-packet latency target: 10 s.

panels.title: URLLC one-way latency (device -> data network)
panels.description: Rolling 60 s window from kpi_collector.py. Sender and receiver share one monotonic clock, so this is exact one-way delay.

panels.title: Measurement packets per second, by slice
panels.description: Sent by traffic_agent.py in the UE container, received in each slice's data network.

panels.title: Slice orchestrator — demands admitted by measured capacity, run as real flows
eMBB: capacity, admission limit, admitted, measured
panels.description: Admission uses max(admitted, measured): load the orchestrator never admitted still uses up capacity. The feedback controller (ADR-016) moves the admission limit between 10 % of the capacity and the capacity. Requires scripts/open5gs/start_orchestrator.sh.

panels.title: URLLC: capacity, admission limit, admitted, measured
panels.description: Best-effort demand never spills into URLLC when eMBB is full (ADR-012). URLLC's limit moves only with CONTROL_THROTTLE="eMBB URLLC": measured, URLLC's own flows do not inflate its latency, eMBB's do (ADR-016).

panels.title: Executed flows that got their rate
panels.description: met = >= 95 % of the admitted bitrate delivered with <= 2 % loss. Pre-empted flows are left out: they were stopped on purpose.

panels.title: Delivered / admitted rate per slice (last 200 flows)
Dynamic allocation — priority inside URLLC and the feedback controller (ADR-016)
What the controller watches: URLLC p95, last 10 s
panels.description: kpi_owd_recent_ms from the URLLC data network's collector. Above the upper line eMBB's admission limit is cut; below the lower one, with demand pressing on the limit, it is raised.

targets.legendFormat: cut above (80 % of the 10 ms budget)

panels.title: Demands by ARP priority level (per minute)
panels.description: ARP 1 = critical URLLC devices (may pre-empt), ARP 2 = standard URLLC devices (may be pre-empted), 8 = eMBB, 12 = IoT. A pre-emption shows as a lower-priority 'preempted'.

panels.title: Network orchestrator — slice lifecycle and compute (ADR-017)
Slice deployed and serving (1) or dormant (0)
panels.description: Discovered from the infrastructure every 15 s, never remembered: containers running, UEs parked or up. Requires scripts/open5gs/start_netorch.sh.

panels.title: UEs holding a PDU session, per slice
panels.description: From the UEs themselves, and the SMF's own count: deactivation must bring both to 0.
